headline: Junior Software & Applied AI Engineer
summary: AI Engineering graduate with distinction who thinks in complete systems rather than isolated features. Has taken products from ambiguous requirements to working software across backend, frontend, data, infrastructure, realtime synchronisation, and applied AI. Works pragmatically, documents trade-offs, and enjoys owning technical problems from first design to reliable delivery.
internship_bullets: Turned an open-ended medical research question into a usable Python product with DICOM processing, computer vision, OCR, structured output, and GUI review tooling.
Designed resumable workflows, validation queues, logging, and cross-platform handoff documentation with reliability and future maintenance in mind.
Reduced one representative source-video matching run from roughly 21 hours to 23 minutes through metadata-guided OpenCV alignment.
apolloon_bullets: Designed and delivered a paid local-first operations product with React, TypeScript, Express, Electron, SQLite, tRPC, and Socket.IO.
Owned system-level concerns including operator UX, API boundaries, LAN discovery, realtime synchronisation, replication, health visibility, and failover.
